name: Rensselaer County, NY
findings: Rensselaer County has 571 nonprofit organizations. 304 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 262 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rensselaer County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
